tests.name: Backup restore isolation, integrity and rollback
tests.name_ar: اختبار الاستعادة المعزولة وسلامة البيانات والتراجع
requires: Prepared local PostgreSQL cluster (runner starts it if offline)
Full-scope PostgreSQL Custom backup from the active Dar backup folder with its matching .backup.json sidecar manifest
tests.impact: Creates/restores/drops uniquely named temporary databases only; may start the existing local PostgreSQL cluster with the shared mutex; never runs initdb; reads production database for before/after signature; does not rename, write to, or replace the production database
tests.run_all: skipped by design; run individually because a backup file must be selected
tests.description: Selects a full backup created by System Center, Backup Scheduler or API all-scope backup with a verified SHA-256 sidecar manifest; restores to a unique temporary database, compares every public table row count and required schema object with production, rejects an invalid archive, and tests swap rollback using disposable databases only.

tests.name: Migration rehearsal: restored database API smoke test
requires: built API DLL and frontend wwwroot
user-selected same manifest-backed full backup accepted by Test 8
selected backup archive with supported migration history
Run BUILD_DAR_FOR_REHEARSAL.bat to compile API and React assets without starting Dar or touching PostgreSQL
tests.impact: Restores the selected archive into a uniquely named disposable database; starts the API against that database with PostgreSQL default_transaction_read_only=on; verifies the health endpoint, React entry and assets; compares table row counts, applied migrations and validated schema objects before/after. Physical database size is logged separately because PostgreSQL background maintenance may change it without changing business data. Production database is checked logically and is never intentionally written.

tests.name: Teacher schedule overlap production preflight
tests.name_ar: فحص تمهيدي للجدول الحالي قبل ترحيل منع التداخل
tests.impact: must run before launching candidate r6.2 or applying Migration 012; starts only the prepared existing PostgreSQL service if needed, then runs a SELECT-only diagnostic inside a PostgreSQL READ ONLY transaction against the current Dar database. the SQL removes PostgreSQL base64 MIME line wraps (76-character wrapping) so each conflict is one complete ASCII row; psql writes rows to a unique temporary file, then the runner decodes UTF-8 JSON and removes the file. It never changes business rows, schema, or backups

tests.name: Inspect affected teacher timetable and audit trail
tests.name_ar: فحص مواعيد حلقة جزء تبارك وسجلها التاريخي
requires: Prepared existing local PostgreSQL 17 cluster on 127.0.0.1:55432
tests.impact: read-only SELECT against the current Dar database. Lists every schedule row for the affected circle plus active schedules for the same teacher across other circles. Shows exact stored TIME, seconds after midnight, duration, active/trash state, created_at in Africa/Cairo, attendance counts, legacy circle schedule text and available audit events. Runs in a PostgreSQL READ ONLY transaction; does not apply migrations, alter rows, create databases, or delete anything.

tests.name: Backup manifest, rehearsal build & PostgreSQL native process source
tests.name_ar: فحص Manifest النسخ وبناء بروفة الاستعادة ومعالجة أخطاء PostgreSQL الخارجية
tests.impact: Read-only source inspection. Confirms the System Center, Backup Scheduler and API all-scope full-backup paths write SHA-256 sidecar manifests; API failure cleanup cannot delete a prior backup on a filename collision; Test 8/10 default to the active verified backup folder; the build-only .NET/React workflow prepares Test 10 without starting PostgreSQL or applying migrations; and the shared PostgreSQL process wrapper safely captures native STDERR under ErrorActionPreference=Stop.

tests.name: PostgreSQL native STDERR / AllowFailure handling regression
tests.name_ar: اختبار التقاط أخطاء PostgreSQL الخارجية دون كسر AllowFailure
tests.impact: Creates a unique temporary directory and a disposable copy of cmd.exe named psql.exe. Verifies native STDERR capture, non-zero exit codes, -AllowFailure behavior and ErrorActionPreference restoration. Does not start PostgreSQL, read local DB secrets, or access Dar data.

tests.name: Functional API acceptance — isolated database
tests.name_ar: اختبار القبول الوظيفي عبر API على قاعدة معزولة
requires: Built .NET 10 API DLL and React wwwroot assets
tests.impact: Creates a unique dar_functional_test_* database, applies all 14 SQL migrations, starts a narrowly gated API child on 127.0.0.1:5082 connected only to that disposable database, exercises student/enrollment/attendance/finance API workflows and permissions, reads production only for a before/after logical signature, stops the exact API child, verifies port release, then drops only the allow-listed disposable database. Run individually; it is skipped by Run All.

tests.name: Functional API acceptance source & isolation guards
tests.name_ar: فحوص مصدر القبول الوظيفي وحواجز عزل قاعدة الاختبار
tests.impact: Read-only source/PowerShell AST inspection. Verifies the API test mode is restricted to loopback port 5082, PostgreSQL 17 port 55432, dar_app and dar_functional_test_* databases; verifies the runner uses a unique disposable database, all 14 migrations, production before/after signatures, guarded cleanup and expected API/finance scenarios. Does not start services or connect to PostgreSQL.

tests.name: Build output & stale Dar API recovery source
tests.name_ar: فحص نافذة البناء والتشخيص/الإغلاق الآمن لواجهة API العالقة
tests.impact: Read-only source/PowerShell AST checks. Confirms the build launcher pauses on success and failure, records a durable transcript with the exact project root and artifact paths, Test 32 reports port owners and missing artifact paths, and the port 5080 cleanup helper revalidates the exact Dar API process and requires typed PID confirmation. Does not start or stop services and does not access the database.

tests.name: Financial artifacts UI/API source guards

Checks receipt upload/download security, operating and advertising expense API permissions/validation, immutable collection snapshots, UI permission gating, report print/export helpers and Test 36 isolation. Does not start services or access PostgreSQL.

tests.name: Financial artifacts API acceptance — isolated database
tests.name_ar: اختبار الإيصالات والمصروفات والتقارير على قاعدة معزولة
requires: Built .NET 10 API DLL and runtime wwwroot in this exact project folder
tests.impact: Creates only a strict dar_functional_test_<16 hex> database, applies all 14 migrations, starts a gated child API on 127.0.0.1:5082, tests valid/invalid receipt upload and authorized receipt retrieval, finance.create-only redaction, operating and advertising expense permissions and month proration, collection-report snapshot immutability after a later payment, and production before/after logical signature equality. Stops only its child API and drops only the allow-listed disposable database after confirmed port release. Run individually; skipped by Run All.
tests.run_all: skipped by design; isolated API listener and database acceptance must run individually

ui: English Test Center; System Center current WinForms UI retained for this release; full Cairo typography and visual redesign is deferred to a dedicated UX session.; Database Studio first delivery is a fixed-query read-only catalog explorer; no arbitrary SQL editor or mutation controls are exposed.
